It is read the way source 90 read its negated existential -- state the proposition with a FROZEN atom instead of a missing connective -- as `12 mod 5 != 0`, built from the already-admitted `mod` term word and the builtin disequality.  For a nonzero modulus that is the same proposition, not a weakening, so 102 is a SHIPPED source and NOT a `refused:not-connective` row.  103/104 are ground congruences read as residue equalities (mod-to-mod, the source-88 reading, never a new congruence primitive), pinned on both signs as 91/92 pinned parity.  105 is the first HYPOTHETICAL congruence and the only nonlinear one (a*b^2 and a^2*b in one term); ch3 problem-022's prose is VERBATIM-IDENTICAL to problem-021's, so this single source retires BOTH ready entries and the batch is 7 sources against 8 ready entries. MEASURED INFRASTRUCTURE FINDING, fixed in this cycle: the corpus crossed 100 sources, and bench_formalize ordered its stream with a plain LEXICOGRAPHIC sort of the source filenames.  That carried the intended meaning only while every number was two digits; at 3 digits `100_...` sorts between `10_...` and `11_...`, so the first run of this batch inserted six of its seven new sources near the FRONT of the stream and recorded them in WAVE 1 -- reshuffling the wave membership of sources committed cycles earlier and breaking the append-only reading that makes `final_wave` mean `the newest batch`.  bench_formalize now keys the corpus order on the integer prefix (`_source_order_key`), which is a PROVABLE NO-OP for every source committed to date (the pre-100 corpus is zero-padded to two digits, where lexicographic and numeric order coincide -- verified against origin/main's 90 sources) and puts this batch back at the end of the stream.  The headline DLs are unchanged by the fix (5666 governed / 6049 ungoverned either way -- the hindsight total is order-free); what moved back is wave membership and the order-dependent prequential column.

C3 cycle-12 census-sourced growth (106-112) plus ONE measured refusal.  Seven of eight selected subjects shipped; all seven certify in BOTH bench arms (all in wave 12), governed exogenous coverage 90 -> 97.  106 is the first source with TWO congruence hypotheses; 107 discharges `there exists an integer a with 6a = 4 mod 11` in the sanctioned WITNESS-TERM form by supplying a := 8 (6*8 = 48 = 44+4), the 84/85/86 precedent, so no exists binder is smuggled in and nothing is universalised; 108 is Fermat's little theorem at p = 3; 111 is the corpus's first source whose whole content is a DISJUNCTION over the parity slot (`or` is one of the fragment's three connectives, so the excluded middle for parity states directly, with no case-split machinery).  109 is ch4 problem-016 -- the LAST subject the evenodd-coverage-decision park was holding, parked by cycle 09 and released by the maintainer's merge of #50; it enters here as ordinary material and closes that park's story.  TWO shapes previously REFUSED were re-measured rather than assumed, and both shipped.  110 negates a congruence and 112 negates a divisibility; both are stated with the FROZEN disequality atom instead of the `not` connective the fragment lacks, the source-90 move.  112 additionally carries an EXISTS BINDER IN ITS HYPOTHESIS -- the shape cycle 09 refused as hypothesis-quantifier.  It is NOT that refusal: `(exists q. P(q)) -> Q` is logically `forall q. (P(q) -> Q)` whenever Q does not mention q, and this conclusion speaks only of a and b, so the flattening is an EQUIVALENCE, not the theorem-changing distortion cycle 09 measured (whose row carries a refuting witness).  The distinguishing property is the conclusion's dependence on the binder, not the presence of `there exists`; the signal's docstring now records that boundary.  112's conclusion also puts the cycle-11 `a mod b != 0` move at a SYMBOLIC divisor, which cycle 11 explicitly declined to generalise: it is faithful HERE for a reason the source supplies -- b = 0 makes the hypothesis `0 < a < 0` unsatisfiable, so both readings are vacuously true at b = 0 and agree on every model.  This is not a general extension to symbolic divisors.  THE REFUSAL: 05_Logic#problem-005 (`there exists a natural k such that k is superpowered and k+1 is not`) is recorded under a NEW appended signal, defined-predicate.  Measured, not assumed: using the name gives `unknown atom/connective 'superpowered'`, and UNFOLDING 05_Logic#definition-001 does not rescue it but RELOCATES the demand -- `unknown atom/connective 'prime'` -- onto what the census already names as the `primality` miss signal (69 nodes).  The new signal is kept distinct from definition-biconditional, which is reserved for the DEFINITION itself; this one names a subject that merely USES one, the same split that keeps iff-connective apart.  The subject's symbolic exponent k^(k^n) is visible in the definition but was NOT reached by the gate, so no symbolic-exponent row was written -- rows record measurements, not expectations.  Its laid-down source file was removed: a refused subject is demand data, never a corpus source.

C3 cycle-15 census-sourced growth (115-119) plus THREE measured refusals.  Five of eight selected subjects shipped; all five certify in BOTH bench arms (all joining wave 13), governed exogenous coverage 99 -> 104.  The batch is the division-algorithm block of 06_Induction plus the corpus's first 07_Number_Theory source, and nothing was purchased to ship any of it: `even`, `odd`, `mod`, the `or` connective and `^` at a LITERAL exponent were all already in the fragment.  115 is the corpus's first parity DISJUNCTION -- cycle 01 had MEASURED that parity candidates displaced the arity-1 even/odd macro and declined to ship them; measured again on the grown corpus, the macro m_f3a9880f19ae survives (b_evenodd_survives=True), so the old avoidance was era-specific and is now retired by measurement rather than by assumption.  116/117 are the first SYMBOLIC-argument uses of `mod` (it had only ever appeared at literal moduli): the lower and upper halves of the remainder bound, each carrying the source's own positivity hypothesis.  118 discharges the division-algorithm EXISTENCE claim by the sanctioned witness-term pattern (sources 84/85/87/107) at r := mod(a,b), with all three of the source's conditions conjoined and none dropped.  119 reads a NON-EXISTENCE claim (no naturals a,b with b != 0 and a^2 = 2b^2) as the equivalent universal -- `not exists` is `forall not`, the side condition carried as a hypothesis and the equation negated with the builtin `!=` atom.  MEASURED AND REPORTED, not hidden: 119's green is COVERAGE, not a refutation-backed verdict.  A deliberately FALSE variant (a^2 != 4b^2, refuted by a=2,b=1) also CERTIFIES, because the five smallest hypothesis-satisfying instances are {a:0,b:1},{0,2},{1,1},{0,3},{1,2} and never reach a=2, while the nonlinear conclusion leaves the SMT arm at nonvacuity-sat only.  The teeth held for the other three tested: dropping 116's positivity hypothesis refutes at d=0, dropping 118's refutes at a=b=0, and reading 115's `either...or` as `and` refutes at n=0.  The THREE refusals are 06_Induction theorems 002, 006 and 010, measured one at a time in the gate's own words: a symbolic exponent (`a^n`), the unknown term operator `div`, and the unknown Bezout coefficient heads `L`/`R`.  Each was ALSO probed past its first blocker and NO probe reached a second missing kind, so each earned exactly ONE row -- unlike cycle 14, where four subjects earned two.  `div` is a NEW appended signal, div-operator: integer division is one standard arithmetic operator word (the shape `mod` itself had as the named refusal mod-operator), so it names a demand ONE purchase meets and is kept apart from function-symbol, whose rows need an arbitrary named function each.  Refused subjects' laid-down files were removed and the five survivors renumbered 115-119 so the corpus numbering stays tight.  No operator word, macro, carrier or trust root grows; kernel/certs.py, TRUST.md, the escape-gate blocklist and ANTI_LIST are untouched; P5 not executed.  Receipt: results/c3_cycle_15.md.

C3 cycle-17 census-sourced growth (122): ONE source, the whole ready list, certifying in BOTH bench arms (joining wave 14); governed exogenous coverage 106 -> 107.  The corpus's first 10_Relations subject: congruence mod n is an equivalence relation, read as the conjunction of reflexivity, symmetry and transitivity over a definitionally unfolded `~` (the relation vanishes the way source 121's set did -- the source defines `~` itself, in fragment, so unfolding relocates nothing).  Congruence rendered as dvd(n, x-y) rather than the residue equality of source 118: BOTH measured, BOTH certify, the two are equivalent for every n (Int.modEq_iff_dvd), and dvd is chosen because it is total at n = 0 (SMT-LIB leaves mod-by-zero unspecified) and because residue equality would collapse all three conjuncts into properties of `=`.  HONESTY: the instance box has teeth on reflexivity and symmetry (false variants of both are refuted, as is an unconditional congruence) but NOT on transitivity -- n | (x+z) in place of n | (x-z) still certifies, because the five smallest hypothesis-satisfying instances are the origin and its four unit neighbours.  That conjunct's green is COVERAGE, not a refutation-backed verdict.  ONE NEW OPERATOR WORD ADMITTED: op_a7da9abc6817, the arity-3 congruence template dvd(v0, v1 - v2), which was PRICED AND REFUSED last cycle (delta +8.0, saving 12.0 < model_bits 20.0 over 3 uses) and crossed the bar ONLY because this one source uses it four times (delta -16.0, saving 36.0, 9 uses; mined witnesses 122, 31_cd_diff, 37_db_diff). The ready list is now EMPTY: every remaining census subject sits in a refused: or parked: group, so the corpus axis has no unblocked material at the current fragment and the next turn belongs to the purchase driver.  No carrier, node class or trust root grows; kernel/certs.py, TRUST.md, the escape-gate blocklist and ANTI_LIST are untouched; P5 not executed.  Receipt: results/c3_cycle_17.md.

C3 cycle-18 census-sourced growth (123-128): the FIRST intake drawn from the frontier's `refused:` blocked groups, and the first movement on the corpus axis since cycle 17 emptied the ready list.  P6 retired three signals; the three groups they gate hold 21 memberships over 18 DISTINCT subjects, and the batch took EIGHT under one ceiling -- the tool run once per retired signal at --take 3 / 3 / 2, its own already-intaken check doing the deduplication.  SIX certify in BOTH bench arms (joining wave 14); governed exogenous coverage 107 -> 113.  123/124 are the `even <-> not odd` and `odd <-> not even` lemmas, the first readings here that need BOTH of P6's words and that have no weaker faithful fallback; the negation is written as a `not` and NOT hand-lowered, because _check_connective_nnf's push to the dual atom is the purchase, and doing it in the reading would turn the subject into the tautology even n <-> even n.  125 is `10 notin {n : Nat | n odd}` read as the GROUND not (odd 10): membership at a LITERAL element unfolds definitionally (Set.mem_setOf_eq -- the source-121 pattern), and this is the subject cycle 16 refused under `not-connective` ALONE, so its flip is the ledger's own pricing coming true.  It is NOT evidence of set coverage: every 09_Sets subject whose set SURVIVES unfolding is still refused.  126/127/128 are the multiple-of and congruence biconditionals, 127/128 rendered with the arity-3 congruence template dvd(v0, v1 - v2) (op_a7da9abc6817) that source 122 admitted, and 128 keeping the literal `n - 0` because that is the corpus's own definition instantiated at 0 rather than an arithmetic step taken on the source's behalf.  TWO REFUSALS, first-class: 03_Parity_and_Divisibility definition-001 and definition-002 -- the definitions of `odd` and `even` -- refuse under `exists-only-shape`, because their definiens is an EXISTENTIAL that has to sit UNDER the biconditional while the fragment's quantifier is a prenex STATEMENT block.  The refusal is EARNED, not asserted: the prenex form still CERTIFIES with the definiens corrupted to the vacuous `a = k`, i.e. it does not carry the definition it claims to render.  So `definition-biconditional` was never one demand: the connective was the outer half, and the inner half is a scope purchase the fragment has not made.  HONESTY on the greens: 126's box has SHALLOW teeth -- the refutation sample is the five smallest instances, so the coefficient corruptions 5 -> 2 / 6 / 10 and the moduli 8 -> 3/4/6/7/9/16 all certify because their least witness is n = 4, and only 5 -> 4 and 8 -> 2 are refuted.  That green is partly COVERAGE, in the cycle-15/17 sense.  No new operator word crossed the admission bar (proposals 51 -> 52); the GC pass retires ONE macro at -7.0 (refined greedy 6233.0 -> census-of-record 6226.0) where cycle 17 retired five at -60.0.  Ready stays 0 and the corpus axis is still purchase-gated, but the window is no longer WEDGED: 12 distinct subjects remain behind the three retired signals, carried as demand rather than widened into this cycle.  No carrier, node class or trust root grows; kernel/certs.py, TRUST.md, the escape-gate blocklist and ANTI_LIST are untouched; P5 not executed.  Receipt: results/c3_cycle_18.md.

C3 cycle-19 census-sourced growth (129): the SECOND intake drawn from the frontier's `refused:` blocked groups, and the FIRST drawn with no purchase in between -- it spends the carry cycle 18 left.  SELECTION applied the frontier's own precedence rule BY HAND, because `intake_from_frontier --unblocked` does not: it hands out the first --take nodes of one named group, blind to the other signals its subjects carry, while a subject returns only when EVERY signal filed against it is met.  Six of the twelve carried subjects qualified; all six were laid down and probed (the ceiling of 8 did not bind), and nothing was reordered to put a likely green in front of a likely refusal.  ONE certifies in BOTH bench arms (joining wave 15); governed exogenous coverage 113 -> 114.  129 is `a^2-5a+5 <= -1 iff a is 2 or 3`, the first source to put P6's `iff` around an ORDER atom rather than a parity or divisibility one and the first to need `or` on an arm of a biconditional, with `^(a,2)` the admitted squaring template op_34e1b706c47c and the quadratic kept in the source's own written order.
